agency.name: Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) - Behavioral Health Services

narrNote: AzRHA appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22) as Arizona's NARR affiliate, and is the state's recovery-residence certifier (1,600+ certified beds per its own site, fetched 2026-10-22).
notes: AHCCCS is Arizona's Medicaid agency and its Single State Agency for substance use per the SAMHSA/NASADAD SSA directory, confirmed on azahcccs.gov (fetched 2026-10-22); the phone shown is published on the agency page. Statewide crisis line is 1-844-534-HOPE (4673), text 4HOPE (44673), operated by Solari; the AHCCCS crisis page also lists per-county crisis numbers. 2-1-1 Arizona is a program of Solari (alternate phone 1-877-211-8661). medicaidSud is AHCCCS's member page on opioid use disorder and treatment, which links the state's OUD service-provider locator. countyDirectory is null: no standalone county-level resource directory could be verified; county routing runs through the AHCCCS ACC-RBHA health plans listed by region on the agency page and through 2-1-1 Arizona's ZIP-code search.
